description: Contract Risk Review is an intelligent contract review tool built on over 40 years of practical experience from a leading law firm in contract review, risk control, and dispute resolution. It helps identify key legal and commercial risks in Chinese contracts, including employment, divorce, lease, entrustment, and sales contracts, and generates structured review reports, actionable revision suggestions, and annotated Word documents to improve review efficiency and signing security.
